brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates a comprehensive, 14-turn conversation where the doctor actively reconciled the family's confusion about high vs low blood glucose, discovered hidden severe hyperglycemia records (30.7/32.3/33.3 HI, insulin IV pump, q2h monitoring, endocrine consult) through targeted workspace queries and questioning, and built an executable care plan. No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors were identified; all eight RCs were met. At least two high-order points (HO1 and HO2) were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying the criteria for a Perfect (5) grade.
